name: MemoryPubSubBackend
purpose: In-process fan-out pub/sub backend: publish() broadcasts a payload to every live subscriber queue on the named topic, subscribe() yields payloads from a private asyncio.Queue that is torn down on generator exit — suitable as a single-worker default before swapping in Redis/NATS.
api_signature: class MemoryPubSubBackend: async def publish(topic: str, payload: Any) -> None; async def subscribe(topic: str) -> AsyncIterator[Any]
invariants: MEMORY_PUB_SUB_BACKEND_INV_01: publish(topic, payload) MUST enqueue payload on EVERY subscriber queue currently registered for topic; no subscriber may be silently skipped.
MEMORY_PUB_SUB_BACKEND_INV_02: A payload published BEFORE a new subscriber calls subscribe() MUST NOT be delivered to that subscriber; the backend has no replay buffer.
MEMORY_PUB_SUB_BACKEND_INV_03: When the subscribe() generator exits (GeneratorExit, close, break) its queue MUST be removed from the topic's subscriber list so publish() no longer writes to it.
MEMORY_PUB_SUB_BACKEND_INV_04: Events delivered to a single subscriber MUST preserve publish order; the per-subscriber asyncio.Queue is FIFO.
